Well presumably the other PW characters will have new Powers as well.  But I can definitely see times when Fanny would like to take some extra damage in order to accomplish even a little - ignoring the possibility of cards giving additional powers, just the innate ability of Tempest or Young Legacy might be worth it under certain circumstances.  There's no telling when you'll want Omnitron-X's power, Expatriette loves to play Unload out of turn, heck even the Scholar might like it.  And of course, the ultimate would be for her to target herself (if that's possible) and then use Sacrosanct Martyr to dish out 8 damage.

My thing is though, that the Promo innate powers have by and large addressed a shortcoming of sorts. Bunkers two promo illustrate this simply. EoW adds to his lack of ongoing destruction, and GI helps strong aversion toward DR. Young Legacy added missing damage potential. Golem Unity added play speed. Dark Visionary frees up her Play phase for more damage oriented cards instead of support ones. Haka and Ra gain card cycling. Redeemer Fanatic gained minor mitigation and speed some speed.

PW Fanatic would raise the ceiling on Martyr to 8 sure, but its still a 1:1 damage ratio. Thats a big "meh" for me. What is interesting is that Zealous Offense would not require Absolution be in play to keep ZO around. Taking 3 damage yourself so 2 noncharacter targets cant deal damage may not be a terrible trade off if you need to keep some spaceships or Char from ripping you to shreds. And since she is a Prime Warden, of course any extra power useage, Embolden or otherwise, will never be wasted on Argent Adept.

 

Ideas for the other known Prime Warden promo powers:

Argent Adept - Reveal the top card of your deck until a Song is found. Activate either its Perform or Accompany text. Shuffle that Song back into your deck. 

Haka - Reduce all damage dealt to hero targets by Environment cards by 1. Draw a card.

Tempest - Place 2 cards from your hand under Tempest's Character card. Increase all Lightning damage Tempest deals by 1 for every 2 cards under this card.

[Redacted] - Something something something energy damage. Thats my best guess.

As the self-appointed defender of the burn yourself down Fanatic I approve of this power.  It still is a 1-1 for Martyr, but 8 damage as a single shot is no joke, that burns a lot of DR granting minions in one shot.  Not too shabby.

I would think that unlike GL PWFanatic would be using her base power sparingly, and be dealing most of her damage with her other cards, but it has some decent uses, and if it is off a sheet of paper in a folder it isn't written in stone.

I would absolutely love it if you took damage and then healed a bit back though, that promo woul be an instant favorite for me.

You could take out Citizen Truth completely with just your power phase, or Runes of Malediction (which is awesome since that gives the rest of the team time to get rid of Effigy.

Beat down significantly on any of the higher health really nasty cards, like EPE or Voss' ships, or the Paradoja Magnifica, or La Capitan's crew.

 

My point, a 5 for 5 damage exchange is very situational, since 5 damage is replicated well by other heroes, but 8 for 8 is a huge chunk of damage that as of right now could swing games and save a lot of HP vs. the 8 you lose.

Situational yes, hurts a lot, yes, but it would also be really powerful.

Then there would be the interplay between GL and Adept and PWFanatic.  Take three send the power Adepts way who does what he can before sending it to GL who sends it back to Fanatic, healing her 1 and letting her Martyr.

Or even just taking three to let Tempest use rain, esp. if you have embolden on yourself.  deal yourself 2 radiant, then play a card, deal yourself three radiant, everyone heals 2, then Martyr with 5 damage already stored.

This Fanatic would play more selfishly and risk death more, and that isn't a popular playstyle for her, but it is effective, much more so if this promo happens.
